texts.zh: 自远古以来，这个文明就与一条强大的龙共享同一恒星系。这个神秘生物的行为在冷淡的仁慈和傲慢的漠视之间摇摆不定。随着行星居民迈入星辰大海，这种关系将如何演变还有待观察。
texts.en: Since time immemorial, this civilization has shared its star system with a formidable dragon. The mysterious creature's behavior sways between distant benevolence and haughty indifference. How this relationship will evolve as the planet dwellers take to the stars remains to be seen.

sections.zh:
我们一直都知道这条龙。自远古时代以来，它就为[GetHomeWorldName]上空增光添彩，我们与它的早期互动散布在[GetSpeciesAdj]各地的民间传说中。很长一段时间，这是一个关于冲突的故事，因为我们早期的武器证明无法与强大的野兽匹敌——但后来的故事讲述了一位有远见的人，他力排众议，设法促成了[GetSpeciesName]和龙之间的和平。

在随后的遭遇中，龙被证明是一个遗世而神秘的形象，它的榜样曾经激励我们努力去追寻星辰大海。然而，快速推进系统的发明与超航道网络的发现带来了与龙的新的、不安的关系时期，因为我们越来越多地侵入它已经孤独地漫游了亿万年的区域。

必须由我们自己来决定我们的未来：我们是会研究龙，或许最终学会与它交流吗？还是我们会陷入冲突，因为单个恒星系的范围太小，无法与如此强大的生物共享？
sections.en:
We have always known the Dragon. It has graced the skies above [GetHomeWorldName] since time immemorial, our early interactions with it scattered throughout [GetSpeciesAdj] folklore. For a long time it was a story of conflict, as our early weaponry proved no match for the mighty beast - but then the stories tell of a visionary who, against all odds, managed to broker peace between [GetSpeciesName] and Dragon.

In subsequent encounters, the Dragon has proved a distant, enigmatic figure whose example has ever spurred our efforts to reach for the stars. However, the invention of rapid propulsion systems and the discovery of the hyperlane network have brought about a new, uneasy period of relations with the Dragon, as we increasingly intrude upon areas it has roamed in solitude for eons.

It is for us to decide what our future holds: will we study the Dragon, and perhaps eventually learn to communicate with it? Or will we be driven to conflict, the confines of a single solar system simply too small to share with such a formidable creature?

sections.zh:
我们一直都知道这条龙。自远古时代以来，它就为[GetHomeWorldName]的上空增光添彩，我们与它的早期互动散布在我们集体意识的阴暗深处。在早期的冲突中，强大的野兽占了上风，我们的武器证明无法与之匹敌——但最终我们能够与它和平相处，从此我们在不安中与之共处。

虽然它仍然是一个神秘的形象，但龙的榜样一直激励我们取得更大的成就，最终发明了能够将我们带入其领域的快速推进系统。现在，随着我们越来越多地侵入它已孤独游荡了亿万年的区域，我们与龙的关系进入了一段不安的时期。

必须由我们自己来决定我们的未来：我们是会研究龙，或许最终学会与它交流吗？还是我们会陷入冲突，因为单个恒星系的范围太小，无法与如此强大的生物共享？
sections.en:
We have always known the Dragon. It has graced the skies above [GetHomeWorldName] since time immemorial, our early interactions with it scattered throughout the murky depths of our collective consciousness. In early conflicts, the mighty beast had the upper hand, our weaponry proving no match for it- but eventually we were able to make peace with it, and we have coexisted uneasily ever since.

Though it remains an enigmatic figure, the example of the Dragon has ever spurred us to greater feats, culminating in the invention of rapid propulsion systems capable of taking us into its domain. Now, as we increasingly intrude on areas it has roamed in solitude for eons, we enter an uneasy period of relations with the Dragon.

It is for us to decide what our future holds: will we study the Dragon, and perhaps eventually learn to communicate with it? Or will we be driven to conflict, the confines of a single solar system simply too small to share with such a formidable creature?

sections.zh:
根据我们的创造者的记录，这条龙一直在[GetHomeWorldName]的上空飞行——偶尔也会降落在地表，他们在古早年代经常同龙发生战斗。在他们的历史后期，他们不安地共存，随着这个生物开始避开他们的同胞，战斗变得不那么频繁。

尽管对他们来说它仍然是一个神秘的形象，但龙的榜样激励我们的创造者取得更大的成就，最终发明了能够将他们带入其领域的快速推进系统。

既然他们的时代已经过去，现在是我们接管了这个星球，那么就由我们来决定我们的未来：我们是会研究龙，或许最终学会与它交流吗？还是我们会陷入冲突，因为单个恒星系的范围太小，无法与如此强大的生物共享？
sections.en:
According to the records of our creators, the Dragon has always flown above the skies of [GetHomeWorldName] - occasionally also landing on the surface, where they often fought in early times. Later in their history, they coexisted uneasily, the fights becoming less frequent as the creature came to avoid their kind.

Though it remained an enigmatic figure to them, the example of the Dragon spurred our creators to greater feats, culminating in the invention of rapid propulsion systems capable of taking them into its domain.

Now that their time has passed and we have taken control, it is for us to decide what our future holds: will we study the Dragon, and perhaps eventually learn to communicate with it? Or will we be driven to conflict, the confines of a single solar system simply too small to share with such a formidable creature?

texts.zh:
倒塌的建筑，坠毁的飞船，成堆熔化的垃圾和被烧成残渣的小巧饰品，这一切说明[rubricator_planet.GetName]的原居民在一次与强大敌人的战斗中被迫逃离了他们的家园。佩戴有他国军徽的尸体则说明这也许是当地鼠群和来自其他星球的鼠群间的一场内斗。

老鼠们试图疏散，但并不成功，因为他们不愿抛下他们珍视的饰品，许多老鼠在急于拿走价值平平的物品时不幸殒命。不过，有一件文物——誊录仪——在他们社会中似乎具有极其特殊的地位。这些老鼠们长时间地殊死战斗以守护该文物，但最后还是不得不弃之而去。
texts.en:
Toppled over buildings, crashed spaceships, lumps of melted junk and trinkets burned to a crisp indicate that the former inhabitants of [rubricator_planet.GetName] fled their homes in the midst of a losing battle against a superior foe. The presence of bodies bearing foreign military insignia suggests it may have been infighting between clans of rats native to different homeworlds.

Their evacuation efforts were impeded by their unwillingness to abandon their treasured trinkets and many lost their lives scrabbling to save completely mundane items. One artifact, however, seems to have held a special place in their society, the Rubricator. It appears that they fought long and hard to save it, but ultimately had to leave it behind.

texts.zh:
尽管四处之景皆为一片“抱头鼠窜”，有一处地方却显得格外整齐。在靠近小镇中心的地方有一栋看上去像是政府大楼的建筑，那是一个数据库，其中存储着他们偷来的每一个物品的来源，对其用途完全南辕北辙的解读，以及一些对于在何处发现这个物品完全没有任何帮助的备忘。

誊录仪被描述成一件具有魔力，能制造神秘的物件，它被放在女皇的丁香缎带的右边，鼻拭子下方，刻着滑稽面孔的四脚桌子的上面……唔，反正就是那个地方。
texts.en:
There is an order to the rats' chaos. In a somewhat official-looking building towards the center of town there is a digital inventory of every single item complete with their origins, gross misinterpretations of their intended uses as well as some highly unhelpful notes on where to find them.

The Rubricator, described as a thingamajig-maker with magical powers, has its place to the right of the empress's lilac ribbon, under her snout-swabs, on the four-legged box with the funny face... wherever that is.

texts.zh:
发掘小队发现了恶臭气味的源头——所见实在是令人不安。靠近市中心的地方堆放着大量干燥的粪便，腐蚀性的消化液积水成潭，这些消化液会释放有毒的硫化氢，考古队员需要戴上氧气面罩才能行动。考古学家无法识别粪便中DNA，但在这些粪堆中发现了未完全消化的居民遗骸。

不管是什么东西吃了这些居民，它都是直接一口吞下的。更加令人胆寒的是，似乎有些粪便还是热乎的。
texts.en:
The excavating team has discovered the source of the foul stench and it is ill-boding. Closer to the center of the city are enormous piles of dried fecal matter and pools of corrosive bile that exude toxic levels of hydrogen sulfide making protective equipment necessary to proceed further. The archaeologists could not identify the alien DNA in the fecal matter but the piles contain partially digested hoarders.

Whatever consumed these aliens swallowed them whole. Even more disconcerting is the discovery of a fresh pile.

texts.zh:
在城市的正中心，穿过主广场，是一座外表装潢极尽奢华的“宫殿”，并饰有一块大红大绿的氙气广告灯牌，上面写着“女皇汽车旅馆”。在旅馆里面，每一个富丽堂皇的房间都装满了金银珠宝，女皇和她深信的顾问团就在这里发号施令。这也是当地的原住民坚守至最后一刻的地方，他们直到咽下最后一口气都在保护他们的女皇和她珍贵的誊录仪。

凭借女皇的丁香缎带，我们或许可以试试运气来找到誊录仪。
texts.en:
At the very center of the city, overlooking the main square, is a grand, ostensibly decorated 'palace' with a garish neon sign advertising the 'Empress Motel'. Inside it are lavish chambers filled to the brim with treasure, from which the Empress and her board of trusted advisers governed. It is also where the hoarders held their last stand, defending their empress and her precious Rubricator.

With any luck the Rubricator can still be found in its usual spot, by the Empress's lilac ribbon...

texts.zh:
在考古学家正准备离开时，他们偶然发现了一间巨大的隐蔽房室，里面充斥着文物，啃过的骨头和大量新鲜的唾液。在那里——一根用过的皇家鼻拭子下方，一张刻有——至少他们认为——十分滑稽的脸的四腿桌上，神秘的制造机——誊录仪就陈放在那里，就在它应该在的位置。那是一个微小的、十分不起眼的立方体，正喷涌出一连串的文物。

誊录仪是一台复制器——一件精巧的外星发明品，可以无限复制几乎任何文物；很快它就是我们的了。行星登陆小队即将启程返回我们安全的飞船中。幸好，我们永远不需要知道是什么袭击了这些居民了。
texts.en:
The archaeologists were preparing to leave when they happened upon a large, hidden chamber cluttered with artifacts, gnawed bones and a substantial amount of fresh slobber. There - under a used royal nose-swab, on a four-legged table with a carving of a face they confirm was indeed funny, sat the Rubricator, maker of thingamajigs, right where it was supposed to be. A tiny insignificant-looking cube, spewing out a continuous stream of artifacts.

The Rubricator is a replicator - an ingenious alien invention that can make endless copies of just about any artifact, and soon it is ours. The planetside team will begin the journey back to the safety of the ship. Thankfully we will never know what attacked the hoarders.

texts.zh:
一头嘶嘶作鸣的，盘旋的猛兽突然从虚空中现身。她仅仅挥动一下巨爪，就抓住了考古队搭乘的穿梭机，连带着发掘小队和誊录仪一齐回到了[Root.GetName]。她将穿梭机拦腰掐断，正打算把誊录仪从里面掏出来。

结果，到头来我们还是把那个将鼠族生吞活剥的存在给惹怒了。这条巨龙似乎被鼠族堆积成山的财宝吸引，于是她将这个宫殿当作了自己的巢穴，顺便还拿原来在这里的老鼠打了个牙祭。很有可能，当我们发掘遗址的时候，她一直藏在暗处窥视着我们的一举一动，只等时机成熟将我们一网打尽。她正对着我们站立的地方吼叫，似乎在说什么。
texts.en:
A snarling, hissing fiend has appeared out of the void. With one swipe of her giant talons she snatched the archaeology shuttle carrying the excavation team and the Rubricator back to the [Root.GetName], bending it open and prying the Rubricator from within.

It seems we have finally had the displeasure of meeting the hoarding rats' assailant. The dragon must have been attracted by their countless treasures and made her nest within the royal palace, feasting upon their bodies. Perhaps she was on the prowl or observed from afar as we excavated the ruins, waiting for the right moment to strike. She appears to be growling something in our general direction.

label.zh: 翻译她那动物般的叫声。

texts.zh: 我们未能击败出现在[Root.System.GetName]星系中的裂爪龙，随后，它向我们在这一恒星系中的殖民地发动攻击，居民遭到屠杀，伤亡极为惨重！
texts.en: Following our failure to challenge the Shard dragon that emerged in the [Root.System.GetName] system, it has turned on our colony in the system, massacring the colonists with great slaughter!

texts.zh: 老鼠的肉质鲜又美，老鼠的骨头嘎嘣脆……现在，轮到你去填饱裂爪的肚子了。是的，小家伙，你们这群小捣蛋鬼。誊录仪是裂爪的。
texts.en: The rats went squeak, squeak, squeak. Then their bones went crunch, crunch, crunch... Now it is your turn to tickle the inside of Shard's belly. Yes, you have been naughty, little ones. The Rubricator belongs to Shard.

label.en: Give back the Rubricator this instant!

title.en: The Demise of Shard the Dragon

texts.zh:
我们的敌人倒在了[From.Root.GetName]的手上。她曾守护的誊录仪遗珍也因此不归我们所有了。

尽管年迈巨龙的威胁被消除了，这一结论看起来很难让人欢欣雀跃。
texts.en:
Our foe has fallen at the hands of the [From.Root.GetName]. The Rubricator relic she guarded has thereby been lost to us.

Although the threat of the old dragon has been removed, it seems difficult to rejoice at this conclusion.

title.en: The Demise of Shard the Dragon

texts.zh:
我们的老敌手倒下了。这条新闻面前有人欢喜有人愁。尽管裂爪龙的威胁被消除了，遗憾的是，看起来誊录仪大概要么和它一道被消灭了，要么很快就会被猎龙者用来复制文物。

但是，龙的遗体不知何故被留在原处，这点是可以确定的，而且遗体本身就值得取回，
texts.en:
Our old foe has fallen. Some rejoiced and others dismayed at this news. Although the threat of Shard is removed, it seems regrettably probable that the Rubricator has either shared her fate, or soon will replicate artifacts for her destroyer.

However, the dragon's remains have for unknown reasons been left behind, that much is certain, and they alone warrant retrieval.

texts.zh:
在从裂爪龙的遗体中提取材料时，[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有了一个令人困惑的发现：誊录仪漂浮在龙鳞与龙血液滴之间。

希望屠龙者没有领会誊录仪的价值，或者最好连其存在都没有发现。
texts.en:
During the extraction of materials from Shard's remains, the [Owner.GetScientistPlural] aboard the [Root.GetName] made a baffling discovery: among the scales and globules of dragon blood drifted the Rubricator.

Let us hope Shard's destroyer failed to grasp its value, or better yet, its existence altogether.

label.zh: 誊录仪现在归我们所有了！

title.en: The Demise of Shard the Dragon

texts.zh: 裂爪，这条邪恶而年迈的巨龙终于咽下了她的最后一口气。在她的脖子旁边，疙疙瘩瘩鳞片下的绒毛上，心脏位置旁边，藏着一个包裹，里面就是她最珍贵的宝物，誊录仪——那个可以复制一切曾经碰到过的文物的遗珍。
texts.en: The vile old dragon known as Shard has drawn her final breath. In a satchel around her neck, nestled in the downy fuzz underneath the gnarled scales above her heart, hangs her most treasured possession - the Rubricator - a relic capable of replicating any artifact it has come in contact with.

label.zh: 誊录仪现在归我们所有了！
让我们看看它的遗骸还藏了什么秘密。
label.en: Let's see what secrets its remains may yield.

texts.zh:
雷鸣般的隆隆声从龙腹中发出，突然，她的翅膀包拢了舰船，呼出的热气让窗户蒙上了厚厚的一层雾气，双眼紧紧地盯着里面，在她的眼中闪过一缕疯狂的光芒。她怎么能够这么快就靠近过来，而且她还在……笑？

“你为什么要激起我的食欲，小家伙。”

她轻声咕噜着，随后向舰船猛扑而去！她毫无保留，露出了满嘴尖牙。
texts.en:
A thunderous rumble erupts from the dragon's belly. Suddenly her wings are wrapped around the ship, her steamy breath fogging up the windshield as she peers inside, a maniacal glint in her eyes. How did she get so close so fast and is she... smiling?

Why you whet my appetite, little ones.

She purrs softly then lunges at it with all her might, fangs exposed.

texts.zh:

她轻声咕噜着，随后向舰船猛扑而去！她毫无保留，露出了满嘴尖牙。

A thunderous rumble erupts from the dragon's belly. Suddenly her wings are wrapped around the ship, her steamy breath fogging up the windshield as she peers inside, a maniacal glint in her eyes. How did she get so close so fast and is she... smiling?

Why you whet my appetite, little ones.

She purrs softly then lunges at it with all her might, fangs exposed.

texts.zh: 她再次展翅高飞。这头曾经贪婪爱财的裂爪龙现在重新看守着[from.solar_system.GetName]星系，不过这一次她是在为我们保护誊录仪。
texts.en: She flies once more. The once-rapacious Shard has returned to watch over the [from.solar_system.GetName] system, but this time she will guard the Rubricator for us!

texts.zh: 曾经贪婪而孤独的裂爪龙现在一动不动。我们已夺取了其僵死的躯壳，废止了她的人格和语言中枢。将这些不必要的系统移除后，我们终于可以控制她的超高温吐息了。
texts.en: The once acquisitive and lonely Shard is now quiet. We have seized her inert body and done away with her personality and language centers. With these superfluous systems removed, her superheated breath is now ours to command.

texts.zh: 我们已经启动死灵机师协议，并复活了该有机实体，名为裂爪龙。突触脉冲正以预期的参数激发。该巨龙已被复活，并受我们的控制。
texts.en: We have initiated Mechromancy protocols, and reanimated the biological entity, designated Shard. Synaptic pulses are firing within expected parameters. The massive dragon has been reactivated and will now respond to our commands.

texts.zh: 我们来自大洋深处，我们的物种完美地适应了深海环境下的生活。即使已经迈入星空，我们仍然没有忘记本源：水体是，也永远是我们的家园。如今，我们的飞升已经完成了——我们不再需要适应其他环境，而是改造其他的星球使其适应我们的需求。当新一天的黎明到来时，我们清楚再也没有什么东西可以让我们与海洋分离了。
texts.en: We came from the ocean, our species ideally suited to living in the depths of the seas. Even as we take to the stars, we have not abandoned our roots: the water is and shall always be our home. Now, our ascension is complete - no longer shall we adapt ourselves to living elsewhere rather than shaping worlds to suit our needs. As we greet the warmth of a new day, we know that nothing needs to take us from the ocean ever again.

label.zh: 这将是一个独一无二的家园。
label.en: It shall be a home like no other.

title.zh: 发现冰封环境改造候选

texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽调查表明这颗行星拥有厚重冰层，因此可以转变为一颗怡人的海洋星球。我们只需将行星大幅度加热，并赋予它可以宜居的大气即可。

对这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造在理论上是可行的，但我们目前所拥有的技术手段还不足以在有实际意义的时间框架内完成这一里程碑式的任务。
texts.en:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed a world with a sufficiently thick layer of ice that it could be restored into a pleasant ocean world, if rendered significantly warmer and bequeathed with a hospitable atmosphere.

Terraforming this [From.GetPlanetMoon] would theoretically be possible, but we do not yet possess the means to accomplish this monumental task within a realistic timeframe.

texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽调查表明这颗行星拥有厚重冰层，因此可以转变为一颗怡人的海洋星球。我们只需将行星大幅度加热，并赋予它可以宜居的大气即可。

巨大的能耗令人望而却步，但我们确实已经掌握了相关的技术手段，可以逐步将这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]环境改造为可以再度支持生命的星球了。
texts.en:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed a world with a sufficiently thick layer of ice that it could be restored into a pleasant ocean world, if rendered significantly warmer and bequeathed with a hospitable atmosphere.

The energy costs would be daunting, but we do have the means to gradually terraform this [From.GetPlanetMoon] into something that would support life once again.

label.zh: 一颗仍存有希望的星球……
label.en: A world for which some hope remains...

texts.zh:
我们已经杀死了天龙！随着最后一颤，最后一声可怕的怒吼，这头野兽最后的生命力流失竭尽。它的尸体仍然完好无损——但这不会持续太久，因为我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]吵着要拿到它去做实验。

在[dragon_planet.GetName]上，气氛喜忧参半。尽管许多人为击败这个令人恐惧的怪物而欢欣鼓舞，但曾经持续存在的巨龙还是对[This.GetAdj]的心灵产生了深远的影响。从某种意义上说，杀死它就像杀死某个人的神。

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在可以期待一个未来，一个凭借能力可以企及任何目标，而无惧超自然力量的未来。
texts.en:
We have slain the sky dragon! With one last shudder, one last terrible roar of fury, the last of the beast's life force drained away. Its carcass remains intact - but not for long, as our [This.GetScientistPlural] clamor to get ahold of it.

On [dragon_planet.GetName], the mood is mixed. Though many rejoice in the defeat of this much-feared monster, the once constant presence of the dragon had a profound impact on the [This.GetAdj] psyche. In a way, killing it is akin to killing one's gods.

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may now look forward to a future where they are capable of anything, where no fear of the supernatural may hold them back from that which they wish to achieve.

texts.zh:
我们已经杀死了天龙！随着最后一颤，最后一声可怕的怒吼，这头野兽最后的生命力流失竭尽。它的尸体仍然完好无损——但这不会持续太久，因为我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]吵着要拿到它去做实验。

在[dragon_planet.GetName]上，气氛喜忧参半。尽管许多人为击败这个令人恐惧的怪物而欢欣鼓舞，但曾经持续存在的巨龙还是对[This.GetAdj]的心灵产生了深远的影响。尽管我们很久以前就放弃了崇拜伪神，但这次行动在象征上更像是彻底地将其放逐。[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在可以期待一个未来，一个凭借能力可以企及任何目标，而无惧超自然力量的未来。
texts.en:
We have slain the sky dragon! With one last shudder, one last terrible roar of fury, the last of the beast's life force drained away. Its carcass remains intact - but not for long, as our [This.GetScientistPlural] clamor to get ahold of it.

On [dragon_planet.GetName], the mood is mixed. Though many rejoice in the defeat of this much-feared monster, the once constant presence of the dragon had a profound impact on the [This.GetAdj] psyche. Though we cast off our false gods long ago, this act is in some way akin to banishing them all over again. [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may now look forward to a future where they are capable of anything, where no fear of the supernatural may hold them back from that which they wish to achieve.

texts.zh:
我们已经杀死了天龙！随着最后一颤，最后一声可怕的怒吼，这头野兽最后的生命力流失竭尽。它的尸体仍然完好无损——但这不会持续太久，因为我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]吵着要拿到它去做实验。

尽管我们的集体意识仔细斟酌过这一举措，但我们仍对此抱有复杂的感受。一方面，我们感到很满意，因为我们征服了死亡的威胁。另一方面，这条长久以来存在的巨龙我们已经……相当熟悉了。虽然我们不像其他太空文明一样，花费很多时间痴迷于那些“超自然”的失去，但在某种程度上，我们仍然会认为这样的行为好似亲手杀死了自己的神明。现在我们可以期待一个我们无所不能的未来，无论多么难以克服的困难都无法阻碍我们。
texts.en:
We have slain the sky dragon! With one last shudder, one last terrible roar of fury, the last of the beast's life force drained away. Its carcass remains intact - but not for long, as our [This.GetScientistPlural] clamor to get ahold of it.

As our collective consciousness considers the deed, we embrace mixed feelings. On the one hand, there is satisfaction: a grave threat has been conquered. On the other, the previously ever-present dragon had become... familiar. Though we have little time for the "supernatural" obsessions of other spacefaring civilizations, in a way, we might consider this act as akin to killing our god. We may now look forward to a future where we are capable of anything, where no obstacle no matter how seemingly insurmountable may constrain us.

texts.zh:
我们已经杀死了天龙！随着最后一颤，最后一声可怕的怒吼，这头野兽最后的生命力流失竭尽。它的尸体仍然完好无损——但这不会持续太久，因为我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]吵着要拿到它去做实验。

尽管我们的处理器进行了重新校准以评估这件壮举的后果，我们却惊讶地发现，我们需要投入相当数量的重构才能实现。曾经存在的龙对我们的编程有相当大的影响，有数十亿个纠错保障来抵消其行动的不可预测性，这将花费一些时间来清理。另一方面，随着这种强大的威胁被清除，我们现在可以期待一个未来，无论多么难以克服的困难，都无法阻碍我们。
texts.en:
We have slain the sky dragon! With one last shudder, one last terrible roar of fury, the last of the beast's life force drained away. Its carcass remains intact - but not for long, as our [This.GetScientistPlural] clamor to get ahold of it.

As our processors recalibrate themselves to account for the consequences of the deed, we find that we have a surprising amount of refactoring to do. The previously ever-present dragon has had a considerable impact on our programming, with billions of fail-safes to counter the unpredictability of its actions, one which will take some time to untangle. On the other hand, with this formidable threat lifted from us, we may now look forward to a future where we are capable of anything, where no obstacle no matter how seemingly insurmountable may constrain us.

texts.zh:
我们成功击杀[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的守护龙！虽然那是一场艰苦的战斗，但它证明了我们舰队很强大。现在[dragon_planet.GetName]的居民将不得不同样地面对敌人，过去那条认为没有人能过越过的巨龙、那种他们可以安全地躲在龙背后的事情已经不复存在。

似乎龙的遗骸在我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]看来是名副其实的宝库，他们相信他们可以发现合成生产龙鳞的方法。
texts.en:
We have slain the Dragon Protector of the [dragon_system.GetName] system! Though it put up a tough fight, it proved no match for our mighty fleets. Now the denizens of [dragon_planet.GetName] will have to face their foes as equals, no longer safe in the knowledge that none can get past the dragon.

It appears that the body it left behind is a veritable treasure trove for our [This.GetScientistPlural], who believe they can find out a way to synthetically produce the dragon's scales.

label.zh: 让我们看看它的遗骸还藏了什么秘密。
label.en: Let's see what secrets its remains may yield.

label.zh: 让我们看看它的遗骸还藏了什么秘密。
label.en: Let's see what secrets its remains may yield.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]击杀了天龙！这一可怕的事实导致[dragon_planet.GetName]现在很容易被攻击。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] has vanquished the Sky Dragon! As a result of this terrible deed, [dragon_planet.GetName] is now vulnerable to attack.

texts.zh: 言出必行，我们的死灵法师已将[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的天龙复活了！虽然结果有些不太相同——正如某些人预料中的将某物由死变活会发生的那样——现在它急切地等待我们的指令。
texts.en: True to their word, our necromancers have returned the Sky Dragon of the [dragon_system.GetName] system to life! Though a little rough around the edges - as one would expect from a being just brought back from the dead - it now eagerly awaits our commands.

texts.zh: 控制天龙是我们长久以来的计划。为了兑现这一目标，我们的工蜂进行了特异性演化。虽然感染的途径仍需要适应，但我们已成为了天龙，天龙亦成为了我们。蜂巢整合了它的知识和经验，我们已经为面对其同族做了充足准备。
texts.en: Controlling the Sky Dragon was always in our plans. Our drones were especially evolved to claim this prize. While the infestation process required some adaptation, we are now the Sky Dragon, and it is us. With its knowledge and experience integrated into the hive, we stand well prepared to meet any of its kin.

texts.zh: 被称为天龙的生物已经由死灵机师协议进行优化。其冰冷的吐息已经低至1开尔文。复活的天龙现已受我方控制。
texts.en: The creature designated Sky Dragon has been overhauled according to Mechromancy protocols. Its freezing exhalations now approach 1 degree Kelvin. The reanimated dragon is now under our control.

texts.zh: 时光飞逝，我亦疑虑。你们一开始是小生物的时候，我就一直在看着你们：你频繁受挫时我也经常感到绝望，而你屡次成功时我也高兴地咆哮。现在，我发现你已经长大了，你的文明已经成熟，并准备好被委托亲子关系的终极责任了。现在是时候让你们再次奉献自己，来帮我抚养我的孩子们了。
texts.en: Time passes, and with it my doubts. From small beginnings have I watched you: often despairing at your frequent impetuity, and yet always roaring in delight at your successes. Now, I find that you have grown, that your civilization has matured, and is ready to be entrusted with the ultimate responsibility: parenthood. It is time for you to rededicate yourselves to rearing my children.

label.zh: 这就是你一直以来的计划吗？
label.en: So this was your plan all along?

label.zh: 那我们又能得到什么回报呢？
label.en: What do we get in return?

label.zh: 我们很荣幸接受你的请求。
我们感谢你的提议，但我们必须拒绝。
label.en: We thank you for this offer, but we must turn it down.

texts.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]观察了天龙，报告称它的内脏似乎发出了巨大的吱吱声。在过去的几个月里，它也异常频繁地在[Root.GetName]周围盘旋，有时会突然掠过大气层的上界，然后再次离开。我们的假设是该生物饿了，希望着陆觅食，就像它过去定期做的那样。不清楚它为什么会犹豫——既然我们已经加入了群星大家庭，也许它想看看我们将如何反应。
texts.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] observing the Sky Dragon have reported loud creaking noises seemingly coming from its internal organs. It has also been circling around [Root.GetName] unusually often over the last few months, sometimes swooping right past the upper reaches of the atmosphere before pulling away again. Our working hypothesis is that the creature is hungry and wishes to land to feed, as it has periodically done in the past. It is not clear why it hesitates - perhaps it wishes to see how we react, now that we have joined it among the stars.

label.zh: 下次它接近时，像它周围打一炮警示它。
label.en: Fire a warning shot next time it comes close.

label.zh: 在一片僻静的宇域为它腾点空间。
label.en: Set aside some space for it in a secluded area.

texts.zh: 龙并没有给我们表现出的敌意好脸色。随着一声巨响——其力量足以在半个星球的范围引发次级地震——巨龙以其冰冷的火焰袭击了[Root.GetName]上的一个人口聚集中心。
texts.en: The dragon did not appreciate our show of hostility. With a loud bellow - the force of which was strong enough to cause minor earthquakes across half the planet - the dragon smote a large center of population on [Root.GetName] with its icy flames.

texts.zh: 龙并没有给我们表现出的敌意好脸色。随着一声巨响——其力量足以在半个星球上引发次级地震——巨龙以其冰冷的火焰袭击了[Root.GetName]，摧毁了重要生产设施，并击杀了大量的子个体。
texts.en: The dragon did not appreciate our show of hostility. With a loud bellow - the force of which was strong enough to cause minor earthquakes across half the planet - the dragon smote [Root.GetName] with icy flames, destroying vital production facilities and killing a large number of drones.

texts.zh:
龙似乎意识到了我们的意图，优雅地俯冲下来，在我们腾出的区域休息。我们留下的大量食物应该有所帮助，必须说——龙在那上面以惊人地贪婪躺平了。

我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正在远处观察它。
texts.en:
The dragon appeared to realize our intentions, and gracefully swooped down to rest in the area we had vacated. The large supply of food we left behind probably helped, it must be said - the dragon has laid into it with astounding voracity.

Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are observing it from a distance.

texts.zh:
在行星上来回几次之后，这条龙显然认为可以安全着陆。尽管它选择了一个僻静的区域，但仍有一些[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被杀死，还有更多人流离失所——鉴于其令人难以置信的体型和贪婪的胃口，这并不奇怪。

它现在已经安顿下来，并以惊人的速度摧毁当地的动植物群。当地居民正与之保持距离。
texts.en:
After several further passes of the planet, the dragon apparently decided it was safe to land. Although it picked a secluded area, a number of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were killed and even more displaced - unsurprising, given its incredible size and voracious appetite.

It has now settled in, and is decimating the local flora and fauna at an alarming rate. The local population is keeping its distance.

texts.zh:
在行星上来回几次之后，这条龙显然认为可以安全着陆。尽管它选择了一个僻静的区域，但仍有一些子个体被摧毁，还有更多子个体流离失所——鉴于其令人难以置信的体型和贪婪的胃口，这并不奇怪。

它现在已经安顿下来，并以惊人的速度摧毁当地的动植物群。当地居民正与之保持距离。
texts.en:
After several further passes of the planet, the dragon apparently decided it was safe to land. Although it picked a secluded area, a number of our drones were destroyed and even more displaced - unsurprising, given its incredible size and voracious appetite.

It has now settled in, and is decimating the local flora and fauna at an alarming rate. Our drones are keeping a precautionary distance.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的丰收中饱食数年之后，现在明显更壮的天龙再次起飞。随着最后致敬的吼声，它升空了——留下了大量的鳞片、脱落的皮肤和其他因它的存在而产生的副产物。
texts.en: After several years of gorging itself on the bountiful harvests of [Root.GetName], the now considerably girthier Sky Dragon has once again taken flight. With a final roar in salute, it lifted off - leaving behind a large collection of scales, shed skin, and other byproducts of its presence.

label.zh: 我们应该研究这些残留物。

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]恒星系中的舰队报告说，在恒星系内遨游的那条龙正在攻击我们的舰船！目前还不清楚它是故意加入[From.Owner.GetAdj]防御战争，还是只是因为我们侵犯了它的领土而对我们感到愤怒。可以肯定的是，如果我们打算夺取[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]，就必须击败它！
texts.en: Our fleets in the [From.GetName] system report that the dragon roaming the system is attacking our ships! It is unclear whether it is deliberately joining the [From.Owner.GetAdj] defense, or if it is simply angry at us for encroaching on its territory. What is certain is that we will have to get through it if we intend to take [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]!

texts.zh: 天龙似乎不愿坐视[From.GetAdj]入侵[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]的行动。它呼啸而起，喷吐出冰焰毁灭了敌人的舰队！
texts.en: The Sky Dragon seems to have taken a dim view of [From.GetAdj] efforts to invade [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]. It soars to our defense, breathing icy destruction upon their fleets!

texts.zh: 天龙似乎不愿坐视[From.GetAdj]入侵[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]的行动。它停止了在行星上进餐，腾飞而起喷吐出冰焰毁灭了敌人的舰队！
texts.en: The Sky Dragon seems to have taken a dim view of [From.GetAdj] efforts to invade [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]. Ceasing its repast on the planet, it has taken flight to breathe icy destruction upon their fleets!

texts.zh:
既然我们已经在理解异种生物学和异星材料方面取得了一些进展，我们的研究人员提议派出科研船对龙进行更进一步的观察。他们对龙鳞格外感兴趣，这些龙鳞十分耐用——甚至无法穿透。虽然我们已经获得了大量自然脱落的样本，我们的科学家对龙鳞如何形成仍然感到困惑。若是使用所谓的“轻微深入”探针，科学家们相信他们可以进入其保护层的下方，直接研究龙鳞的自然过程。

当然，龙不会介意的……当然如此。
texts.en:
Now that we have made some progress understanding xenobiology and exotic materials, our researchers have proposed that we send a science ship to take a closer look at the dragon. They are particularly interested in its scales, which are remarkably durable - even impenetrable. While we have acquired numerous naturally-shed samples, our scientists remain baffled as to how the scales form. Using what they describe as a "mildly intrusive" probe, they believe they can get under the dragon's protective layer and directly study its natural processes.

Surely the dragon will not mind... Surely.

texts.zh:
既然我们已经在理解异种生物学和异星材料方面取得了一些进展，我们可以考虑派出科研船对龙进行更进一步的观察。龙鳞格外引人留意，它们十分耐用——甚至无法穿透。虽然已经获得了大量自然脱落的样本，我们的科学子个体对龙鳞如何形成仍然感到困惑。若是能部署足够深入的探针，我们也许可以进入其保护层的下方，直接研究龙鳞的自然过程。

当然，龙是不会介意的……当然如此。
texts.en:
Now that we have made some progress understanding xenobiology and exotic materials, we may consider sending a science ship to take a closer look at the dragon. Of particular interest to us are its scales, which are remarkably durable - even impenetrable. While we have acquired numerous naturally-shed samples, our science drones remain baffled as to how the scales form. By deploying a sufficiently intrusive probe, we may be able to get inside the dragon's protective layer and directly study its natural processes.

Surely the dragon will not mind... Surely.

label.zh: 试试不那么深入的其他方法吧。

texts.zh:
尽管这条龙专注地看着我们的科研船，但当我们多次对其进行深度扫描时，它没有作出任何反应——以目前的技术水平，这是我们能够做到的最彻底的扫描。这些扫描使我们对龙的生物过程有了新的洞见，可是其鳞片之下的秘密仍然像以前一样难以捉摸。

虽然我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]被迫就这件事承认失败，但他们向我们保证，他们仍能把获得的知识好好加以利用。
texts.en:
Though the dragon watched our science vessel attentively, it did not react as we subjected it to several deep scans - the most thorough we are capable of at our current level of technology. They provided us with fresh insights into its biological processes, though the secret behind its scaly hide remains as elusive as ever.

Although our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are forced to admit defeat on that matter, they assure us that they will nonetheless be able to put the knowledge they have acquired to good use.

texts.zh: 龙似乎饿了。又也许它今天就是心情不好。在我们的舰船接近它的时候，这条龙呲牙低吼，嚼着牙骤然间猛冲向前，不留做出规避动作的时间。我们的科研船现在没剩多少残骸了——至少在龙的肚子之外没剩多少。
texts.en: It appears the dragon was hungry. Or maybe it was just having a bad day. As our vessel approached it, the dragon snarled and abruptly lunged forward in a chomping motion, leaving no time for evasive maneuvers. Little now remains of our science vessel - outside of the dragon's belly, at least.

label.zh: 最好不要进一步激怒它。
喂了它以后现在它应该不饿了。我们再试一次。
label.en: Its hunger should be sated now. Let's try again.

texts.zh: 龙放任我们的科研船靠近，但随着探针发射，它用尾巴以不可思议的力量猛击舰船。值得注意的是，虽然舰船因此越过了半个恒星系，它几乎完好无损，舰上也没有报告人员伤亡。不管怎么说，龙明显不太高兴。
texts.en: The dragon tolerated our science ship's approach, but as the probe was launched, it used its tail to swat our vessel out of the way with incredible force. Remarkably, although the ship was vaulted halfway across the solar system, it was almost entirely undamaged, and no casualties were reported onboard. Nonetheless, the dragon's displeasure was clear.

label.zh: 最好不要进一步激怒它。
有意思。我们应该看看再试一次会发生什么。
label.en: Fascinating. We should see what happens if we try again.

texts.zh: 正当我们的舰船第二次接近龙的时候，它勃然而动，鼻腔中喷射出寒光，如飞梭一般直奔[dragon_colony.GetName]！防御系统还来不及启动，它就暴怒地向这颗行星的北半球倾泻出它的寒冰之息，顷刻间摧毁了多个大型人口中心。
texts.en: As our vessel approached the dragon for the second time, the dragon sprang into action. Nostrils flaring, it darted away, heading directly towards [dragon_colony.GetName]! Before our defense systems could react, it furiously unleashed its icy breath upon the northern hemisphere of the planet, causing considerable damage to several large population centers.

texts.zh: 正当我们的舰队第二次接近龙的时候，它勃然而动，鼻腔中喷射出寒光，如飞梭一般直奔[dragon_colony.GetName]！防御系统还来不及启动，它就暴怒地向这颗行星的北半球倾泻出它的寒冰之息，顷刻间摧毁了无数关键生产设施。
texts.en: As our vessel approached the dragon for the second time, it sprang into action. Nostrils flaring, it darted away, heading directly towards [dragon_colony.GetName]! Before our defense systems could react, it furiously unleashed its icy breath upon the northern hemisphere of the planet, causing considerable damage to vital production facilities.

label.en: Let's back off for a while.

texts.zh:
我们的探针牢牢抓住龙，发现了它鳞片间的一个狭小缝隙并灵巧地钻了进去时，龙愤怒地低吼着。在[Root.GetName]准备强制超光速以回避被激怒的龙的时候，探针已经开始收录令人称奇的数据了。从这些数据中我们发现，其鳞片之所以如此强韧，是由于它在高速进入[dragon_colony.GetName]大气层的过程中，激活的一系列复杂的酶促反应造成的。

虽然还有许多未解之谜，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]算是弄清了一件事：由于龙体生理学的复杂性，如果我们想要获得这种鳞片的材料，唯一的办法是屠龙。尽管如此，他们还是保证已经获得的知识无论如何也是有用的。
texts.en:
The dragon snarled in fury as our probe latched onto it and swiftly located and burrowed into a minute gap between its scales. While the [Root.GetName] was forced to engage emergency FTL to avoid the displeased dragon, the probe was able to pick up intriguing readings. From what we can tell, the durability of the dragon's scales is the result of a complex cocktail of enzymes that trigger a unique chemical reaction when the creature enters the atmosphere of [dragon_colony.GetName] at high speeds.

Though much is left to uncover, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are clear about one thing: due to the complexity of the dragon's biology, if we wish to gain access to the material from which its scales are made, we will have to kill it first. Nonetheless, they assure us that the knowledge they have gained will be useful, either way.

texts.zh: 在我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]和[This.Owner.GetLinguists]排查了所有同龙进行交互的已知记录之后，他们准备进行数项实验以测试它的反应。他们保证所有的动作都是经过了仔细的论证，一旦龙表现出哪怕是最轻微的不满，所有活动都会立刻中止。
texts.en: As our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] and [This.Owner.GetLinguists] trawl through the records of known interactions with the dragon, they have prepared a few experiments to test its responses. They assure us that every move is planned with due diligence, and that they will cease their activities at the slightest sign of displeasure from the dragon.

texts.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]还在为龙的发声这一科研难题在艰苦奋战。尽管他们心里抱着希望，期冀马上就能突破，然而在我们和这样一只体型庞大的太空飞龙之间寻找能够作为参考的共同框架，可能本身就存在着极大的困难，这使得这样的障碍更加不可逾越。

这可能会造成沮丧的气氛，尽管这并不是源于龙的行为本身：它对于我们的科研船闯入它的领域展现出了惊人的耐心。根据它喉咙活动产生的韵律，它正不断地产生同一组声门震动——吼叫或者哭喊，显然不是对着真空的宇宙——就好像它知道我们正在做什么，还希望能够帮忙。
texts.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] remain stumped by the dragon's utterances. Though they are hopeful that a breakthrough is just around the corner, the difficulties inherent in finding a common frame of reference between ourselves and an enormous spacefaring dragon remain seemingly insurmountable.

This would be cause for despair, were it not for the behavior of the dragon itself: it has been remarkably patient with our research ships intruding on its space. Based on the rhythmic movements of its throat, it has been repeating the same set of glottal vibrations - roars or cries, were it not for the vacuum of space - almost as if it knows what we are doing, and wishes to help.

texts.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]报告了令人咋舌的突破。就在他们绝望地以为永远无法理解龙的时候，他们将它不断涨落的身体能量辐射转置成为了声音波形。随后他们聆听了结果，他们简直不敢相信自己的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]。毫无疑问：龙在讲我们的语言，只不过使用的是不同的媒介。它的吼叫，事实上，只是想要引起我们的注意，而不是试图进行交流。

根据已有的知识，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]重新播放了旧的记录。根据这些记录，龙在过去的吼叫是“令人失望地、孩子气般地”抱怨食物的品质和“行星上的爬行生物”们缓慢的进度。然而，这头生物现在表现出极大的惊讶和喜悦，因为我们能够理解它。事实上，多年以来它表现出来的好意都被我们漏掉了。显然它希望同我们对话，这可是一件至关重要的大事，但是必须在我们已经“准备好了”之后才行。
texts.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] report an astounding breakthrough. Despairing at ever being able to understand the dragon, they transposed the spectral map of its fluctuating corporal energy emissions to acoustic waveforms. As they listened to the results, they could not believe their [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]. It was undeniable: the dragon was speaking our language, but in a different medium! Its roars were, in fact, only meant to draw our attention, rather than an attempt at communication.

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] replayed old recordings with this knowledge in mind. According to them, the dragon's past utterances have been "disappointingly puerile" grumbling about food and the slow progress of the "planet crawlers." Nevertheless, the creature now expresses surprise and pleasure that we are able to understand it. Indeed, it displays an alacrity not seen for many years. Apparently it has a matter of great importance that it wishes to speak with us about, but only when we are "ready."

texts.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]报告了令人咋舌的突破。就在他们绝望地以为永远无法理解龙的时候，他们将它不断涨落的身体能量辐射转置成为了标准波形偏差图。结果表明它实际上在用简单的二进制代码“说话”，并且和我们平常使用的相差不大，只不过使用的波长不一样。它的吼叫，事实上，只是想要引起我们的注意，而不是试图进行交流。

根据已有的知识，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]重新播放了旧的记录。根据这些记录，龙在过去的吼叫是“令人失望地、孩子气般地”抱怨食物的品质和“行星上的爬行生物”们缓慢的进度。然而，这头生物现在表现出极大的惊讶和喜悦，因为我们能够理解它。事实上，多年以来它表现出来的好意都被我们漏掉了。显然它希望同我们对话，这可是一件至关重要的大事，但是必须在我们已经“准备好了”之后才行。
texts.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] report an astounding breakthrough. Despairing at ever coming to understand the dragon, they transposed the spectral map of its fluctuating corporal energy emissions into a standard wave deviation graph. This revealed that it was in fact "speaking" in simple binary code, not dissimilar to that which we sometimes use, just on a different wavelength. Its roars were, in fact, only meant to draw our attention, rather than an attempt at communication.

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] replayed old recordings with this knowledge in mind. According to them, the dragon's past utterances have been "disappointingly puerile" grumbling about food and the slow progress of the "planet crawlers." Nevertheless, the creature now expresses surprise and pleasure that we are able to understand it. Indeed, it displays an alacrity not seen for many years. Apparently it has a matter of great importance that it wishes to speak with us about, but only when we are "ready."

label.zh: 但是我们已经准备好了！

texts.zh: 龙发表了一段冗长的谩骂，谈及了它在数个纪元积累的智慧，以及它观察我们对时间和使命的态度——甚至都懒得提我们对宇宙的基础那肤浅得可悲的理解。很明显它认为我们太年轻，太单纯，太鲁莽，在现阶段还配不上这个任务。
texts.en: The dragon launches into a lengthy diatribe about the wisdom it has accumulated over the eons, and its observations regarding our attitude toward time and commitments - not to mention our still-pitiful knowledge of the fundamentals of the universe. Apparently it considers us young and reckless, and unworthy of this quest at present.

label.zh: 哎呀。我们得奋斗，不能躺了。
label.en: Alas. We shall strive to be better.

texts.zh: 我们不太清楚哪里出了差错，但是我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]看上去引得龙颜大怒。一声威震天穹的怒吼之后，这头生物将致命的龙息倾泻在他们的舰船之上，杀死了[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]——同时给我们试图理解它的工作造成了重大的挫折。
texts.en: We are not quite sure what went wrong, but our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] seem to have displeased the dragon. With a mighty roar, the creature unleashed its deadly breath upon their vessel, killing [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] - and setting us back considerably in our attempt to understand it.

texts.zh:
[This.GetName]汇报在[From.GetName]星系目击了一条骇人的太空巨龙！

这个恒星系似乎是[From.Owner.GetName]的中心，其中一颗行星显示出拥有稠密人口的痕迹。

目前为止，这条龙还没对我们采取行动，也没有与这个恒星系中的另一群居民存在冲突的迹象。也许我们最好还是别管他们吧。
texts.en:
The [This.GetName] reports sighting a terrifying space dragon in the [From.GetName] system!

The system also appears to be a center of the [From.Owner.GetName], with one of the planets in the system showing signs of particularly dense population.

So far, the dragon has not reacted to us, nor is there any sign of conflict between it and the other inhabitants of the system. Perhaps it would be best to leave it be.

texts.zh:
我们大获全胜的舰队在濒死的缇扬奇族母身旁游弋，她那闪闪发亮的肉身上布满了弹孔和伤痕。她那巨大的触须虽然仍试图捕捉附近的舰船，但动作逐渐放缓，最终停了下来。

就这样，古老的族母被终结了，就像那些在我们之前企图围捕她的舰队一样。
texts.en:
Our victorious fleet circles the dying Tiyanki Matriarch, her glowing flesh scored by countless blast-marks. The violent thrashing of her tentacles, still trying to grasp at nearby ships, first slows, then draws abruptly to an end.

At last she expires: the ancient Matriarch laid to an end, like her would-be hunters before us.

label.zh: 从这头巨兽身上收集基因物质。
label.en: Harvest genetic material from the beast.

texts.zh:
我们还是把事情想的太简单了，上将报告说怪物的肚腹中有奇怪的东西在动。

有什么东西要从怪物肚腹中钻出来了！
texts.en:
...Or so it had seemed. Our fleet captains are reporting strange movement coming from the belly of the beast.

Something is about to emerge!

title.en: From the Belly of the Beast

texts.zh:
一艘沾满了黏液、腐蚀严重的神秘舰船冲出了缇扬奇族母的肚腹，我们舰队做好交战准备，但那艘船突然关闭了武器系统和引擎系统。

他们向我们发来联络！
texts.en:
A mysterious vessel, covered in viscous fluids and damaged by digestive juices blasts its way out of the corpse of the fallen Tiyanki Matriarch. Our fleet stands at the ready, but the ship immediately powers down its weapons and engines after emerging.

They are hailing us!

texts.zh:
我是亚哈船长号的舰长瑞斯·昂多，我们被困在这怪物肚中已经很久了，几十年前我为了复仇而准备消灭这只怪物。

结果报仇不成，我们的舰船反倒被这怪物给吞下去了，我还以为这辈子再也没机会看到宇宙群星了，多亏了你们帮忙。

为了感谢你们拯救我们脱险，我们的舰船从现在开始向[Root.GetName]效忠。
texts.en:
This is Captain Reth Unddol of the AH4B. Long have I suffered in the caustic bowels of that fell beast. Decades ago I came to hunt it, to repay a debt long overdue.

Alas, I could not lay this baleful Matriarch to an end, and when she swallowed the AH4B whole, I was certain I would never again see the light of the stars. I am glad to see I was mistaken.

For putting my nightmare to rest, I would pledge my life and loyalty, and my ship, to the [Root.GetName].

title.en: From the Belly of the Beast

texts.zh:
等等！不！你不能——不要碰我！

啊啊啊啊！
texts.en:
Wait! No! You cannot -- get away from me!

HRGAAAAHHH!!

title.en: From the Belly of the Beast

texts.zh:
绝对不行。这艘船就是我的命根子……你们在干什么？你们不能把我塞进逃生舱！

住手！我的话还没说完……！
texts.en:
Out of the question. This ship has been my only lifeline for... what are you doing? You cannot just stuff me in an escape pod!

Stop! You haven't heard the last of me...!

texts.zh: 经过一段漫长的仪式，缇扬奇族母从彼岸归来，并为我们的事业而效力。
texts.en: After a lengthy ritual, the Tiyanki Matriarch has returned from beyond and now serves our cause.

texts.zh:
复活缇扬奇族母格外困难。即便我们已经有控制她小型子嗣的丰富经验，但族母的再生能力反复地吞噬掉我们的虫草[root.GetNecromancersLower]。但最后，我们更胜一筹；死掉的组织永远也不可能比我们更具适应力。

现在，我们控制了族母，她的巨型鞭毛已经为我们所用了。
texts.en:
Reanimating the Tiyanki Matriarch was especially difficult. While we have gained plenty of experience seizing control of its smaller offspring, the Matriarch's regenerative capabilities proved to be a significant drain on our cordyceptic [root.GetNecromancersLower]. But in the end, we triumphed; no dead tissue could ever adapt faster than us.

Now, having taken control of the Matriarch, we twitch the titanic flagella.

texts.zh: 缇扬奇族母已重新启动并重目的化。该巨型生物将作为一个有机单元服务于我们。将其原生的族母协议停用后吧，该星神兽现在将为我们所控制。
texts.en: The Tiyanki Matriarch has been rebooted, and repurposed. This titanic creature will now serve us as an organic unit. With matriarchal protocols disengaged, this leviathan will now operate under our control.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]核心内部有什么东西开始稳定地脉动，定期使地面产生轻微的颤动。那像是心跳一般的声音几乎令人感到宽慰。

但我们担心那声音可能变得越来越大。地质学家正在密切监测星球，留意危险的地质运动。
texts.en:
Something deep within the core of [From.GetName] has begun to pulsate at a steady pace, sending gentle ripples through the ground at regular intervals. It gives off a soft almost soothing sound, similar to that of a heart beating.

Concerns have been raised, however, that the sound may be growing in strength. Geologists are monitoring the planet closely for signs of dangerous seismic activity.

texts.zh:
仅仅过了一年之久，在[hatchling_egg.GetName]上新成立的殖民地就发生了一系列灾难性的大地震，将地貌变成了无法辨识的地狱景象。地表上出现许多深不见底的裂隙，有的甚至横穿整块大陆，并从地壳深处喷出硫磺气体与有毒液体。

这种地震现象通常是由地幔内的岩浆流造成的，但在[From.GetName]上根本没有地震活动，除了从地核里发出的不祥震动之外。当地行政机构已开始怀疑殖民地的长期可行性。
texts.en:
Barely a year old, the newly established colony on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has been shaken by a series of devastating earthquakes that are transforming the environment into an unrecognizable hellscape. Deep rifts, some spanning entire continents, are forming across its surface, spewing sulfuric gasses and noxious liquids from deeper within the crust.

Such seismological phenomena are typically caused by magma currents in a planet's mantle but on [From.GetName] there are no indications of seismic activity at all, except for the ominous pounding from the planet's core. Local authorities are beginning to question the colony's viability in the long-term.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]正在经历一系列地震变化，将原本美丽的环境变成了无法辨识的地狱景象。地表上出现许多深不见底的裂隙，有的甚至横穿整块大陆，并从地壳深处喷出硫磺气体与有毒液体。

卫星数据显示地核深处在发出强烈的声波能源，就好象心跳一般。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] is going through a series of rapid seismic changes that are transforming the formerly pristine environment into an unrecognizable hellscape. Deep rifts, some spanning entire continents, are forming across its surface, spewing sulfuric gasses and noxious liquids from deeper within the crust.

Satellite data shows strong bursts of sonic energy pulsating from the planet's inner core, as from a heart beating.

texts.zh:
一阵猛烈地震袭击了[hatchling_egg.GetName]，使地壳破裂并释放出大量的有毒气体与黏液，使所有生物窒息。

[hatchling_egg.GetName]上发生的变化恐怕无法复原，并且程度严重到星球近期都无法居住。当地行政机构已宣布进入紧急情况，并要求所有剩余的居民进行疏散。

与此同时，星球地核深处的脉动正在变得越来越强。
texts.en:
A shockwave of earthquakes has struck [hatchling_egg.GetName], rupturing the lithosphere and expelling a blanket of toxic gasses and sludge, that is now smothering all living things.

We fear the changes on [hatchling_egg.GetName] are irreversible and substantial enough that the planet will be uninhabitable within a near future. Local authorities have declared a state of emergency and request that all remaining inhabitants be evacuated.

Meanwhile, the rhythmic pulses from the planet's core are growing in strength.

texts.zh:
又一场猛烈地震袭击了[hatchling_egg.GetName]，使地壳破裂并释放出大量的有毒气体与黏液，使所有生物窒息。

[hatchling_egg.GetName]上发生的变化无法复原，并且程度严重到星球近期都无法居住。

与此同时，星球地核深处的脉动正在变得越来越强。
texts.en:
Another shock wave of earthquakes has struck [hatchling_egg.GetName], cracking the lithosphere open and expelling more toxic gasses and sludge that now blanket the surface, smothering all living things.

The changes to [hatchling_egg.GetName] are both irreversible and substantial enough to render the planet uninhabitable within a near future.

Meanwhile, the rhythmic pulses from the planet's core are growing in strength.

texts.zh: 灾难降临在了[hatchling_egg.GetName]的殖民地上！最后一波剧烈的地壳破裂彻底地撕碎了殖民地的残骸，空壳之下，一只可怕的虚空孳孽幼体如梦魇一般降临！这违背了一切常理，但也没有其它的解释。我们误以为它是颗星球，可它其实是颗蛋，而现在那颗蛋已经孵化了。
texts.en: Disaster has befallen the colony on [hatchling_egg.GetName]! A final sequence of violent ruptures has razed the last remains of the settlement and cracked the planet open, and from its empty shell is bursting the nightmarish form of a newborn Voidspawn. It goes against all sense, still there is no other way to explain it. Somehow what we mistook for a world was not a world at all, but an egg, and that egg has now hatched.

texts.zh:
[hatchling_egg.GetName]已经不存在了！最后一波剧烈的地壳破裂彻底地撕碎了这颗行星，一只巨大到难以想像的怪兽幼体从星球内破壳而出。

这违背了一切常理，但也没有其它的解释。我们误以为它是颗星球，可它其实是颗蛋，而现在一只噩梦般的虚空孳孽已经孵化了出来。
texts.en:
[hatchling_egg.GetName] is no more! A final sequence of violent ruptures has cracked the planet open and from its empty shell crawls the newborn form of a creature of unimaginable proportions.

It goes against all sense, still there is no other way of explaining it. Somehow what we mistook for a world was not a world at all, but an egg, that has now hatched a nightmarish Voidspawn into the galaxy.

texts.zh:
[hatchling_egg.GetName]上的奇怪地震活动突然停止了。不再有震动，不再有新的裂隙，不再有地核深处传来的不详脉动。星球已经彻底安静了下来，并且如果我们运气好的话，也将继续如此。

我们现在只能重建损失。
texts.en:
The strange seismic activity on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has stopped abruptly. There are no more tremors, no new rifts, no ominous pulsating from its core. The planet has grown quiet and with any luck it will stay that way.

All that remains now is to rebuild what was lost.

texts.zh: [hatchling_egg.GetName]上的奇怪地震活动突然停止了。不再有震动，不再有新的裂隙，不再有地核深处传来的不详脉动。星球已经彻底安静了下来，并且如果我们运气好的话，也将继续如此。
texts.en: The strange seismic activity on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has stopped abruptly. There are no more tremors, no new rifts, no ominous pulsating from its core. The planet has grown quiet and with any luck it will stay that way.

texts.zh: 一只巨大到难以想像的怪物，正在小心翼翼地从一颗星球移动到另一颗星球。从其别扭的比例与笨拙的身手来看，它还只是个幼崽，但仍然同样可怕。它身上粘着一丝丝的黑色黏液，利爪从其掌间伸出。无论幼崽与否，它都是一只天性凶猛的捕食者。
texts.en: A creature of unthinkable size is fluttering clumsily from planet to planet. Judging by its awkward proportions and movements it is only a spawn yet, but it is horrifying to behold all the same. Strings of slime and black bile cling to its body and sharp mandibles. Spawn or not, it is a predator, equipped to kill.

texts.zh:
虚空孳孽蜷曲的身体发出一阵轻微的震颤，黑色液体从其伤口与鼻口中泄出，接着它便消逝了，眼睛茫然地凝视着虚空。

但愿我们永远不会见到它生长至成年期的样子，或是其生母的所在之处。

我们的科学家对研究其蛋壳保留能源的独特能力表示很感兴趣。
texts.en:
A light tremor passes through the Voidspawn's curled up body, ribbons of black fluid trailing from its wounds and snout, then it is gone, its liquid eyes staring emptily into space.

Hopefully we will never know the form it might have taken if allowed to reach adulthood, or the whereabouts of its originator.

Our scientists have expressed an interest in researching the egg shards for their unique energy retaining qualities.

label.zh: 别。我们不想再与虚空孳孽有任何牵扯。
label.en: No. We are done with the Voidspawn.

texts.zh: 我们的死灵法师将躯体装回它原来所在的卵中，孵化了新的虚空孳孽以效力于我们的事业。
texts.en: Our necromancers returned the body to the egg from which it came, and hatched the Voidspawn anew to serve our cause.

texts.zh:
将虚空孳孽装回卵中并再次将其孵化的操作竟然极其地有效。利用卵中残留的原生物质，我们的死灵[root.GetNecromancersLower]可以轻易地编辑这具躯骸来服务我们。

将这只生物制成提线木偶后，我们现在可以扇动它的翅膀了。
texts.en:
Returning the Voidspawn to its egg and incubating it again proved to be incredibly efficient. By making use of the primordial matter still inside the egg, our [root.GetNecromancersLower] easily edited the corpse to service us.

With the creature thus puppeteered, we now flex it's wings.

texts.zh: 通过实施死灵机师协议，我们可以复活已死的虚空孳孽，替代性翅膀已经由实验性生化合金铸成。
texts.en: Utilizing Mechromancy protocols, we have been able to reanimate the terminated Voidspawn. Replacement wings have been forged using an experimental bio-alloy.

texts.zh: 在仔细研究蛋壳碎片之后，我们开发出了一种科技，可以使我们的太阳能电厂获得类似虚空孳孽之卵的能源保留能力。
texts.en: A closer analysis of the egg shards has allowed us to develop a technology that will reproduce some of the Voidspawn egg's remarkable energy retaining qualities in our own solar plants.

texts.zh:
我们面临着一个抉择：

如果我们对蛋的碎片进行近距离分析，我们便有可能再现一些虚空孳孽卵的非凡的能量固存特性。

或者是我们可以保存好虚空孳孽的基因物质以备未来使用。
texts.en:
We are faced with a choice:

If we conduct a closer analysis of the egg shards, we could potentially reproduce some of the Voidspawn egg's remarkable energy retaining qualities.

Alternatively, we can preserve the genetic material of the Voidspawn for future use.

texts.zh:
可怕的以太巨龙已经被击杀。英勇无畏的指挥官[From.From.GetLeaderName]和[From.From.GetName]将流芳百世。

之前那头巨兽千方百计守护的那颗小行星现在可以放心开采了。谁知道它千百亿年以来积累了怎样的宝藏？
texts.en:
The formidable Ether Drake has been slain. The exceptional bravery of Commander [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the [From.From.GetName] will not soon be forgotten.

The planetoid the beast guarded so jealously can now be safely exploited. Who knows what treasures the creature might have amassed over the eons?

label.zh: 让我们看看它的遗骸还藏了什么秘密。
label.en: Let's see what secrets its remains may yield.

texts.zh: 在忙碌了好一阵子后，我们的死灵法师让以太巨龙再次充满了能量。意识融合的结果颇有些摇晃不稳，但我们觉得这还是很成功的，毕竟这个生物的超高温吐息仍可以正常运转。
texts.en: After much work, our necromancers have once more filled the Ether Drake with energy. The resulting fusion of consciousness is lurching and unnerving, but we will call this a success as long as the creature's superheated breath still functions.

texts.zh:
以太巨龙的躯体似乎坚不可摧。放弃对劫持其中枢神经并从中控制的尝试后，我们被迫用仿生[root.GetIndividualName]逐一替换它的神经。

让我们看看能不能让这具躯壳再发出吼声吧。
texts.en:
The Ether Drake's biology appeared at first to be impenetrable. Instead of hijacking its central nervous system and assuming control from there, we were forced to replace every one of its nerves with a [root.GetIndividualName] facsimile.

Let's see if we can make the husk roar.

texts.zh:
这颗星球上存在一个由一群沉迷于捡垃圾及囤垃圾的哺乳动物组成的社会。他们迷宫般的城市到处都是垃圾，高耸的建筑摇摇欲坠，由各种破烂拼成。目之所及尽是堆积成山的小摆件、饰品和手工艺品。

这些小家伙自己并不能生产任何东西，但他们精通太空旅行，他们可能从外人那里偷了不少用得着的东西，但同时也偷了不少没用的东西。
texts.en:
This planet has played host to a mammalian society of compulsive gatherers and hoarders. Their labyrinthine city is littered with junk, their towering ramshackle buildings pieced together from scraps of re-purposed materials. As far as the eye can see are mountains of knick-knacks, ornaments and artifacts.

The tiny ratlike inhabitants did not produce any goods of their own but were proficient spacefarers who likely pilfered the things they needed, as well as a whole lot of things they did not need, from other alien cultures.

sections.en:
This planet has played host to a mammalian society of compulsive gatherers and hoarders. Their labyrinthine city is littered with junk, their towering ramshackle buildings pieced together from scraps of re-purposed materials. As far as the eye can see are mountains of knick-knacks, ornaments and artifacts.

The tiny ratlike inhabitants did not produce any goods of their own but were proficient spacefarers who likely pilfered the things they needed, as well as a whole lot of things they did not need, from other alien cultures.

texts.zh: 我们已经得到了誊录仪——一件外星文物——的最后已知坐标，其位于一个我们从未探测到的恒星系。虽然我们还不清楚这件文物的意义，但是据说它蕴含巨大的能量。
texts.en: We have uncovered the last known location of the Rubricator, an ancient alien artifact, in a previously uncharted system. Though we do not yet know its purpose, it is rumored to hold great power.

texts.zh: 我们的科研船将大胆地发射探针，这一探针会将自身植入龙鳞之下，揭开龙那独特生命形态的奥秘。
texts.en: Our science vessel will boldly launch a probe that will implant itself underneath the dragon's scales and uncover the secrets of its unique biology.

texts.zh: 我们的科研船将在安全距离上对龙进行扫描，揣摩其独特生命形态的奥秘。
texts.en: Our science vessel will scan the dragon from a safe distance to divine the secrets of its unique biology.

texts.zh: 裂爪龙，老鼠们的噩梦，誊录仪的收藏者，现在只留下了一具毫无生机的躯壳，静静地围着恒星公转。我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]设想，既然裂爪龙活着的时候能够保护这台誊录仪，那她在死后应该也能效力于誊录仪的新主人。
texts.en: The Shard, rat-terror, Rubricator-keeper, and now dead husk, orbits around the local star. Our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] posit that, as the great beast guarded the Rubricator in life, so should it serve the Rubricator's new masters in death.

texts.zh:
年迈的巨龙被另一个国家消灭了，大概往好了说也只是一厢情愿，但还是希望她最珍贵的财产，誊录仪，会被忽视掉并留在原处。

文物另说，龙的遗体本身就能算是个财宝库。
texts.en:
With the old dragon's demise at the hands of another, it is perhaps wishful thinking at best that her most treasured possession, the Rubricator, would have been overlooked and left behind.

Artifacts aside, a dragon's remains alone could be a treasure trove.

texts.zh: 虚空孳孽的卵进化出了通过吸收邻近恒星的能源来忍受严酷太空环境的能力。或许这些碎片可以揭露它的秘密。
texts.en: Somehow the Voidspawn egg has evolved to survive the harsh conditions of space, by absorbing and conserving huge amounts of solar energy. Maybe the remains of the shattered shards could reveal its secrets.

texts.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]现在已经构想出了一项大胆的计划用于复活缇扬奇族母，这样她就能效力于我们，伴随在舰队旁一同战斗了。
texts.en: Our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] have hatched an audacious plan to bring the Tiyanki Matriarch back from the dead, so she may serve us and fight alongside our fleets.

title.zh: 复活被杀死的虚空孳孽

texts.zh: [Owner.GetNecromancersLower]向我们保证他们能通过某些不可告人的方式将虚空孳孽复活，并使其效力于我们，伴随在舰队旁一同战斗。
texts.en: Through methods best not spoken of aloud, our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] assure us that they are capable of resurrecting the Voidspawn to serve us and fight alongside our fleets.

texts.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]相信他们能够用一些仪式与科技结合的手段让以太龙再吐龙息，比如从当地恒星收集等离子体、向巨龙尸体中加装寄生引擎等等诸如此类的手段。
texts.en: Our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] believe that they can reignite the spark within the Ether Drake through a blend of ritual and science: gathering plasma from the local star, attaching cordyceptic engines to the corpse, and so on.

texts.zh: 虽然[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的龙被击杀了，但我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]向我们保证，这种事态不会持续太久。他们承诺，他们很快就可以复活它——并且安全地成为我们的奴仆——很快。
texts.en: Though the dragon of the [dragon_system.GetName] system has been slain, our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] assure us that this state of affairs need not last long. They promise that they can revive it - safely in thralldom to us - in short order.
